protocol.universe: eligible names ranked by close-t lagged 60-session median traded value; N=50/100/200; requires >=252 bars, traded t, >=55/60 sessions traded, median value>=KRW1bn
protocol.holdings: fixed K=20 for each universe; each position is 1/K=5% NAV; fewer than 20 signals leaves unfilled weight in cash
protocol.rsi2: Wilder RSI2 (alpha=1/2) <=10 and close>SMA200; daily signals; exit at close>SMA5 or completed age>=5; fills next tradable open
protocol.gap: prior close top-N liquidity universe + prior close>SMA200; at next open require gap<=-2.5%; enter at that day close, exit at next session close; K=20; tradability defers exit
protocol.residual: month-end top-N universe; trailing252 daily log return OLS with intercept vs KODEX200 (>=200 paired); score sum of prior126 daily residuals; positive score; top20; fill next open
protocol.costs: 0.015% commission each side; 0.20% sell tax; 0.05/0.10/0.25/0.50% tier slippage by lagged 60-session median traded value
protocol.benchmarks: KODEX200 buy-hold; monthly EW of contemporaneous top-N liquidity universe, same execution costs
protocol.terminal_handling: only fetch-log confirmed delisted IDs get last-close proxy and costs; unknown data tails stay stale marked, unresolved exposure/PnL separate

contamination: same panel and market path previously examined; not untouched OOS
